## Introduction 

This project was to read a professional paper about a topic within data science, and then create a poster with all of the relevant information from the paper. Myself and Brett Hartlaub read "The Elements of Graphing Data Well' by Steve Figard, which was written as a guide to properly create effective visualizations for data.
